action.text: Task: Add regression tests for port access on urlsplit/urlparse results (text and ASCII byte URLs) covering: no port, empty port, 0, 65535, 65536, negative port, noninteger port, non-ASCII decimal digits. Also add documentation. Need to understand implementation: port validation logic, exception type, argument tuple, message text. Implementation is authority. From search: port property at line 176 checks port.isdigit() and port.isascii(), then int(port), then 0 <= port <= 65535. Raises ValueError with specific messages.
